const response = $input.first().json;
const products = response.products || [];

if (!products.length) {
  return [];
}

const transformed = products
  .filter(p => p.code && p.product_name)
  .map(p => ({
    json: {
      code: p.code,
      product_name: p.product_name || '',
      brands: p.brands || null,
      quantity: p.quantity || null,
      serving_size: p.serving_size || null,
      categories: p.categories || null,
      categories_tags: p.categories_tags || null,
      main_category: p.main_category || null,
      labels: p.labels || null,
      labels_tags: p.labels_tags || null,
      origins: p.origins || null,
      origins_tags: p.origins_tags || null,
      manufacturing_places: p.manufacturing_places || null,
      stores: p.stores || null,
      countries: p.countries || null,
      nutriscore_grade: p.nutriscore_grade || null,
      nutriscore_score: p.nutriscore_score || null,
      nova_group: p.nova_group || null,
      ecoscore_grade: p.ecoscore_grade || null,
      ecoscore_score: p.ecoscore_score || null,
      energy_kj: p.nutriments?.['energy-kj_100g'] || null,
      energy_kcal: p.nutriments?.['energy-kcal_100g'] || null,
      fat: p.nutriments?.fat_100g || null,
      saturated_fat: p.nutriments?.['saturated-fat_100g'] || null,
      carbohydrates: p.nutriments?.carbohydrates_100g || null,
      sugars: p.nutriments?.sugars_100g || null,
      fiber: p.nutriments?.fiber_100g || null,
      proteins: p.nutriments?.proteins_100g || null,
      salt: p.nutriments?.salt_100g || null,
      sodium: p.nutriments?.sodium_100g || null,
      fruits_vegetables_nuts_percent: p.nutriments?.['fruits-vegetables-nuts-estimate-from-ingredients_100g'] || null,
      alcohol: p.nutriments?.alcohol_100g || null,
      calcium: p.nutriments?.calcium_100g || null,
      iron: p.nutriments?.iron_100g || null,
      vitamin_c: p.nutriments?.['vitamin-c_100g'] || null,
      vitamin_d: p.nutriments?.['vitamin-d_100g'] || null,
      ingredients_text: p.ingredients_text || null,
      allergens: p.allergens_tags || null,
      traces: p.traces_tags || null,
      additives: p.additives_tags || null,
      additives_n: p.additives_n || null,
      image_url: p.image_url || null,
      image_small_url: p.image_small_url || null,
      image_ingredients_url: p.image_ingredients_url || null,
      image_nutrition_url: p.image_nutrition_url || null,
      packaging: p.packaging || null,
      packaging_tags: p.packaging_tags || null,
      url: p.url || null,
      creator: p.creator || null,
      created_t: p.created_t || null,
      last_modified_t: p.last_modified_t || null,
      last_modified_by: p.last_modified_by || null,
      states: p.states || null,
      states_tags: p.states_tags || null,
      completeness: p.completeness || null,
      last_synced_at: new Date().toISOString()
    }
  }));

return transformed;
